AOE was diagnosed in an estimated 2,067,335 ambulatory-care clinic visits and 377,440 ED visits
An estimated 2.4 million U.S. health-care visits result in a diagnosis of AOE annually
visits peaked in the summer (44% occurred during June--August)
53% of visits occurred among adults aged ≥20 years
An estimated 2.7% of ED visits for AOE during 2007 led to hospital admission
median: 15 minutes per visit; mean: 17 minutes
With a mean cost of $200 per nonhospitalized AOE visit
the annual rate of ambulatory-care visits for AOE was highest in the South (9.1 per 1,000 population)
which was not significantly more than for men (p=0.30)

methods_quotes.q: Statistical software was used to apply sampling weights and account for complex sample design.
Statistical significance was determined by the Rao-Scott modified chi-square test (alpha = 0.05).
Total national visits were estimated by summing the NAMCS and NEDS estimates
Only visits resulting in a diagnosis of AOE without concurrent otitis media were included in the analyses.
Range is derived by summing respective 95% confidence limit upper and lower bounds
